title: Stevie Wonder - You Haven't Done Nothin' (1974)

lines.l: We are amazed, but not amused
For all the things you say that you do
Though much concern but not involved with decisions that are made by you
But we are sick and tired of hearing your song
Telling how you are gonna change right from wrong
Cause if you really want to hear our views
It's not too cool to be ridiculed
But you brought this up on your shelf
The world is tired to pacify
We want the truth and nothing left
We would not care to wake up to the nightmare that's becoming real life
But when misled, who knows a person's mind can turn as cold as I
Why do you keep on making us hear your song
Telling us how you're doing right or wrong
Cause if you really wanna hear our views
